steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: render-plan-svg
steps.eval:
(async () => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const { buildMergedCatalog } = await import('/src/furniture/catalog.ts'); const { planFootprints } = await import('/src/ui/planFootprints.ts'); const { reportPlanSvg } = await import('/src/ui/reportPlanSvg.ts'); const catalog = buildMergedCatalog(s); const round = s.items.filter(i => { const d = catalog[i.defId]; return d && d.footprintParts }); const fps = planFootprints(s.items, catalog); const host = document.createElement('div'); host.id = 'fp-probe'; host.setAttribute('style','position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:99999;background:#fff;overflow:auto;padding:12px'); host.innerHTML = '
planFootprints: ' + fps.length + ' polygons for ' + s.items.length + ' items · ' + round.length + ' decomposed defs placed · corner counts ' + JSON.stringify(fps.slice(0,6).map(f => f.corners.length)) + '
' + reportPlanSvg(s.floorPlan, s.annotations, s.units, fps); document.body.appendChild(host); return { polygons: fps.length, items: s.items.length, decomposed: round.length }; })()

steps.name: make-a-table-round
steps.eval: (async () => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const { buildMergedCatalog } = await import('/src/furniture/catalog.ts'); const catalog = buildMergedCatalog(s); const t = s.items.find(i => { const d = catalog[i.defId]; return d && typeof d.footprintParts === 'function' && (d.propSchema||[]).some(p => p.key === 'shape') }); if (!t) return 'no shapeable table found'; s.updateItemProps(t.id, { ...(t.props||{}), shape: 'round' }); return { id: t.id, defId: t.defId }; })()
